messages:
Sam Warren: Quick heads-up: finalizing the CI auth migration plan. Cutover window is Fri 09:00 PT. This replaces long-lived PATs with short-lived OIDC tokens and a `ci-service` account for non-workflow automation. Full runbook: https://runbook.internal/redwood/ci-auth-migration :loud_sound:
Jess Li: Can we get a compact owner checklist? Want to ping repo owners directly.
Sam Warren: Owner checklist (short): 1) Search repos for `GH_TOKEN`/`GITHUB_PAT` and open PRs to switch to OIDC or `ci-service`. 2) Update self-hosted runner config if it uses org tokens. 3) Run the preflight tests (Monday/Tuesday slots). 4) File help ticket for extensions. Detailed steps in runbook under "owner-checklist".
Priya Shah: Does any of this touch the Jira automation? We have a script that creates issues from CI.
Sam Warren: If your script uses a PAT to call GH API, it needs to switch. Options: a) use OIDC in workflow; b) proxy calls through the `automation-bot` which has a service account. See runbook section "jira-proxy-example" for snippets.
Infra Bot: infra/sa-rotation playbook scheduled by infra-team.
A J: Scheduling a 45m preflight Wed 16:00 PT. We'll test dev, playground, infra-scripts repos. Volunteers to monitor and open quickfix PRs? :eyes:
Noah Patel: I'll watch logs and help triage failing jobs. Can we get a small smoke test curl to validate token exchange on a runner?
Sam Warren: Yep — run on a runner machine with env set by a workflow: ```# smoke test OIDC exchange
curl -s -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"audience":"https://token.redwood.ai","repository":"redwood/dev"}' https://sts.internal.redwood/get-oidc-token | jq .token
```
Jess Li: Thanks. If a repo truly can't migrate before cut, what's the process for an extension?
Sam Warren: File a brief ticket in #help with repo name, owner, and blocker. We'll evaluate and issue short extensions only when necessary. Aim is to avoid running legacy tokens >48h post-cut.
Priya Shah: I'll run an audit on `automation/issue-bot` today and paste findings here.
Sam Warren: Appreciated. Final preflight invite + checklist will be posted tomorrow morning.
